 Justice Sibo Sankar Mishra
Order Order

In the present case, the petitioner has challenged the order dated 25.04.2022 passed by the learned G.N., Raghunathpur in G.R. Case No.32 of 2021 corresponding to Raghunathpur P.S. Case No.34 of 2021, whereby the cognizance of the alleged commission of the offences punishable under Sections 419/420 of the IPC r/w Sections 66(C)/66(D) of the I.T. Act has been taken.
2.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that, after the investigation, the police has filed the closure report.
However, the learned trial Court has taken the cognizance against the petitioner on the police report.
She has assailed the same in the present petition.
Learned counsel for the petitioner read out the statement of the witness under Section 161 of the Cr. P.C. to impress upon the Court that no case is made out against the petitioner.

3. I have carefully gone through the evidence placed on record by the I.O. and I am of the opinion that at this stage, this Court shall not exercise the jurisdiction under Section 482 Cr. P.C by appreciating the evidence placed by the police along with the report except to arrive at a prima facie view.
However, liberty is granted to the petitioner to move appropriate application before the trial Court raising all the points as has been raised in this petition at the appropriate stage.
